scope: uploaded visual reference lock for the production FormatX MAG, single-context real 3D ownership, calibrated mobile framing, proven shader, layered luminous glass material, cache-busted v30 r2 assets, diagnostic live startup gates, mobile/desktop visual evidence, white-core position evidence and live deployment

reference_contract.target: user-supplied four-tip luminous crystalline sci-fi core reference, 2026-08-10
reference_contract.silhouette: long vertical needle tips, wide horizontal tips, concave transparent sails
reference_contract.material: stable proven shader plus layered luminous cyan-blue glass and dense cyan/violet indexed filaments
reference_contract.reactor: small moving white-cyan emitter inside the crystal with four thin real 3D rings
reference_contract.spectral_orbits: thin real 3D cyan and violet rings around the body
reference_contract.environment: dark navy star field, cyan horizon and perspective energy floor
reference_contract.interaction: subtle pointer parallax plus organism activation/response/speech energy impulses
reference_contract.performance_target: adaptive 60-plus FPS with bounded DPR and pixel budget

mobile_calibration.reactor_ring_aspect: preserved independently from shell vertical stretch

material_calibration.contour_density: every radial shell ring plus denser longitudinal filaments
material_calibration.outer_orbit_opacity: reduced to keep the crystal body dominant

validation_model.position_metric: weighted centroid of the bright white-cyan reactor core within the central search window
validation_model.shell_metric: separate mobile/desktop live visual gate for spectral coverage, brightness and extent

acceptance_policy: Iteration 5 is accepted only if the cache-busted stable v30 renderer reaches ready-v30 live, production smoke and Lighthouse pass, mobile/desktop visual metrics pass, white-core position passes, and the resulting live Chromium screenshot is directly compared with the uploaded reference.
